Saml2._comment: ClassLink SSO (SAML 2.0). EntityId must match this app's actual public URL + /Saml2 once known - placeholder for now. IMPORTANT - the URL below is NOT StaffManagement's own ClassLink connection: clicking 'Login with ClassLink' against it redirects into an existing 'Apex Learning' app's SSO flow and errors there (confirmed by testing). It was given as an example of ClassLink's URL *pattern* (idp.classlink.com/sso/metadata/{connection-id}), not the real value. A district ClassLink admin needs to create an actual SAML app connection for StaffManagement in ClassLink's admin console (pointed at this app's /Saml2 metadata endpoint) and supply *that* connection's metadata URL here before real login will work. Left pointed at the example URL so local dev can still exercise the redirect/metadata mechanics in the meantime.
